results.title: Che-Chia Wei - Crunchbase Person Profile
results.snippet: Che-Chia Wei is based out of Hsinchu and is the Chief Executive Officer of Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company. Che-Chia Wei previously worked at President and Co-Chief Executive Officer at Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company. Che-Chia Wei attended the National Chiao Tung University and Yale University.

results.title: TSMC Arizona - Crunchbase Company Profile & Funding
results.snippet: In the city of Phoenix, TSMC Arizona aims to represent the world's most advanced semiconductor technology in the United States.

results.title: Lora Ho - Crunchbase Person Profile
results.snippet: Lora Ho is the Chief Financial Officer and Spokesperson of Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company Limited (TSMC). Joined TSMC in 1999, Ms. Ho served as Corporate Controller from 1999 to 2003, and became the Chief Financial Officer since 2003.
